name: Sekapp Orchard
description: In Rochester, MN, Sekapp Orchard raises Apples, Pumpkins, Corn, and Honey on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
